title: Senior Developer wey sabi Windows Systems
meta: Salary aligned with the market + typical French benefits (Health Insurance, 50% Transportation card)
html:
Wetin di work be

Di person wey we go pick go dey in charge of dis tins:

  • To design, build and make low-level Windows system components for Kyber run well well
  • To build Windows services, system agents and drivers (for user-mode and kernel-mode, depending on wetin di work need)
  • To work direct with native Windows API dem (Win32, NT Native API) and connect with di Windows ecosystem (Active Directory/Kerberos and di rest)
  • To find and settle hard wahala wey concern performance, memory management, synchronization and security
  • To do serious debugging (to analyse crash dump, kernel debugging, to check stack, and sometimes reverse engineering)
  • To write technical documents wey clear and wey go last
  • To join hand for low-level architecture decisions and for di code reviews wey matter pass
  • To dey follow wetin dey happen for Windows internals and system-level tools every time.

Di technical skills wey we need

  • You must sabi how Windows dey work inside and im ecosystems well well
  • You gas understand synchronization mechanisms, memory management and how to handle errors for system level + You suppose clearly know where user-mode stop and where kernel-mode start, plus how to manage user sessions
  • You don use your hand work with Windows debugging and analysis tools
  • Programming languages wey you go use: C / C++ / Rust / x86/x64
  • Tools and environment: Visual Studio and Windows toolchains, GitLab and di way team dey take work together for development

Who you be

  • You don do 5 to 10 years for software development as professional, and you don focus well well on Windows systems programming
  • Record dey show say you don work for systems wey hard for technical side and wey dey very important
  • You get strong low-level reasoning and you fit understand big codebase wey don already dey ground
  • You dey thorough, you fit work on your own, you dey look small small details, and you like to solve technical palava wey no easy
  • You fit share wetin you sabi and guide junior engineers

Skills wey go add sweet (no be by force):

  • Experience for system security or to make Windows components strong pass, background for reverse engineering or malware analysis, contribution to open-source projects wey concern low-level or systems work
  • Experience for environment wey get tight condition (real-time systems, systems wey no suppose fall down, software wey security matter well well)

How di interview go waka

  1. First call of 15 minutes: Quick yarn about wetin dey push you, if you go fit di work, and we go answer your questions wey no be technical.
  2. Two technical/product interview, 1 hour each: We go dig deep into how you dey take solve problem, with our CTO and/or our lead solution architect
  3. Meet di team, greet dem: Free-free gist to make sure say you and di team culture go jell well.

Wetin we go give you

  • Projects wey get plenty technical work and wey go challenge your brain
  • Environment wey value real engineering skill and wey focus on tech (no useless meetings or reports)
  • Plenty freedom to take technical decisions
